reference.title: Scenario 12 — Admonition Between Numbered List in a Procedure
reference.shortdesc: Consider a procedure where the author has inserted an admonition (Note or Warning style paragraph)

section.p: Consider a procedure where the author has inserted an admonition (Note or Warning style paragraph) between two numbered steps to call out a safety or precautionary detail relevant to the step just completed.

row.entry: [Heading 2]: Update Firmware [List Number]: 1. Download the firmware file. [Warning style]: Do not disconnect power during the update. [List Number]: 2. Run the update utility.

entry.codeblock:
Update Firmware Download the firmware file.

Do not disconnect power during the update.

 Run the update utility.

section.p: Result: The converter treats the admonition paragraph as supporting information tied to the preceding step and nests it inside <info><note> rather than splitting the procedure into two separate <steps> blocks. The admonition style (Note, Warning, etc.) determines the type attribute of the generated <note>.
